title: Create Diesel Compat (IE diesel generator) (Datapack)
description: Makes Create: Diesel generators diesel work in Immersive Engineering Diesel Generator.
body:
**Create Diesel Compat (IE Diesel Generator)**
Lets Create: Diesel Generators' diesel and biodiesel fluids can now power the Immersive Engineering Diesel Generator.

Diesel burns at 285 burn time, matching Immersive Engineering's Sulfurized Diesel.

Biodiesel burns at 250 burn time, matching Immersive Engineering's Biodiesel.

Originally made for and intended to be used with Immersive Factory - Create and Immersive Petroleum, a NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack built around Create and Immersive Petroleum's oil/fuel production. This pack closes the gap so fuels produced through Create's refining chain are just as usable in IE's generator as Immersive Petroleum's own fuels.

**What it does**
This data pack adds generator_fuel recipes so Immersive Engineering's Diesel Generator multiblock recognizes both Create: Diesel Generators' diesel and biodiesel fluids as valid fuels.

The burn times are set to match Immersive Engineering's existing fuels:

Diesel → 285 burn time (same as Sulfurized Diesel)

Biodiesel → 250 burn time (same as Biodiesel)

This keeps fuel consumption consistent with Immersive Engineering's intended balance.

No assets, code, or files from either mod are included—this pack only references their public fluid and recipe IDs, the same way any IE-compatible addon does.

**Requirements**
Immersive Engineering (provides the Diesel Generator and the generator_fuel recipe type)

Create: Diesel Generators (provides the createdieselgenerators:diesel and createdieselgenerators:biodiesel fluids)

Minecraft 1.21.1 (Forge), pack_format 48

Does not require Immersive Petroleum. If you happen to have it installed, there's no conflict—this pack uses its own separate fluid entries.

**Compatibility / Version Notes**
This pack targets pack_format 48 (Minecraft 1.21–1.21.1). If you're on a different Minecraft or Immersive Engineering version, the pack may fail to load silently—check /datapack list after /reload.

If the createdieselgenerators:diesel, createdieselgenerators:biodiesel, or Immersive Engineering's generator_fuel recipe type change in a future update, this pack may need to be updated accordingly.
